blocks.title: Nerve impulse
blocks.text: Nerve impulse electrochemical tabdeeliyon ki lehar hai jo neuron ki lambai mein chalti hai.

Tamam cells, neurons samet, cell membrane ke dono taraf barqi charges rakhte hain: andar ki taraf, cytoplasm ki janib, manfi aur bahar ki taraf, extracellular fluid ki janib, musbat hoti hai. Is farq ko membrane potential kehte hain.

Membrane potentials musbat aur manfi ions ki mukhtalif miqdar aur membrane ke aar paar ions ki harkat se bante hain. Zyada tar cells mein ions ki andar bahar harkat yaksan rehti hai, is liye potential bhi yaksan rehta hai; magar neurons aur muscle cells yeh raftar badal sakte hain, is liye un ke membrane potential badalte hain.

blocks.prompt: Aaram karte cell ki membrane ki kaunsi taraf manfi hoti hai?
blocks.explanation: Andar ki taraf, cytoplasm ki janib.

items: Nerve impulse: neuron ke saath electrochemical tabdeeli ki lehar. Membrane potential: andar manfi, bahar musbat; neurons aur muscle cells ise badal sakte hain.
